ato.progress.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.error.need_descriptor: Put this component on the same object as VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.need_descriptor:description: Avatar Texture Optimizer must sit on the avatar root that already has a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
ato.error.need_descriptor:hint: Select the avatar root and use Add Component → FOSA → Avatar Texture Optimizer.
ato.error.multiple_components: Only one Avatar Texture Optimizer is allowed on an avatar (including children).
ato.error.multiple_components:descriptio: Found more than one ATO component under this avatar.
ato.error.multiple_components:hint: Delete the extra components and keep a single one on the avatar root.
ato.warn.whitelist:description: This texture was treated as a whitelist item and was not optimized.
ato.warn.whitelist:hint: If this is unexpected, check ST/rotation, special-purpose maps (matcap/decal), or wrap-crossing UVs.
ato.warn.no_fit: UV group {0} cannot fit the largest atlas and was left un-atlased.
ato.warn.no_fit:description: After quality scaling the islands still overflow the max atlas size for this platform.
ato.warn.no_fit:hint: Lower the quality preset or raise the platform max size.
ato.warn.npot_format: NPOT atlas '{0}' dropped an unsupported compressor (PVRTC).
ato.warn.npot_format:hint: Use ASTC on iOS/Android when NPOT is enabled.
ato.warn.alpha_format: Transparent texture '{0}' cannot use an opaque compressor. Fell back to Auto.
ato.warn.alpha_format:description: A format without alpha would break cutout/blend materials.
ato.warn.alpha_format:hint: Pick DXT5 / BC7 / ASTC / ETC2 RGBA instead.
ato.warn.gray_multichannel: Gray texture '{0}' actually uses multiple channels. Kept a multi-channel format.
ato.warn.gray_multichannel:description: A single-channel compressor would drop used data.
ato.warn.gray_multichannel:hint: Leave the format on Auto, or pack each channel into its own texture first.
ato.info.canceled: Canceled at stage '{0}'. Temporary files on disk were kept.
ato.info.canceled:description: CPU / GPU / memory were released. You can bake again.
ato.info.canceled:hint: Delete Assets/ATO_Generated if you want to reclaim disk space.

ato.ui.help: Add this to the avatar root (the object with VRCAvatarDescriptor). One avatar = one component. Press VRChat Build / NDMF Bake to run. Defaults are safe for beginners.
ato.ui.generate_atlas.tip: On: pack UV islands into atlases. Off: only shrink whole textures and keep original UVs.
ato.ui.whitelist.tip: Any object (mesh / material / texture / clip / GameObject). Every texture it references is left completely untouched.
ato.ui.npot.tip: 64 px steps. Works with MipStreaming and Crunch. PVRTC is removed automatically.
ato.ui.quality_locked: These numbers follow the selected preset. Switch to Custom to edit them.
